youtube.title: How Did FTX Collapse in Only Nine Days?
youtube.description:
In January 2022 FTX was valued at $32 billion. Nine days after a leaked balance sheet appeared in November 2022, it was in bankruptcy court. How did one of crypto's most trusted exchanges collapse that fast, and why is blaming Binance only half the story?

This documentary follows the decision underneath it all: the special account that let FTX's sister trading firm, Alameda Research, borrow without limit. It covers the June 2022 choice to repay lenders, the seven balance sheets, the nine days in November, the trial, and why customers who were 'repaid 118%' still lost most of their bitcoin's value.

sources.claim: FTX valued at $32 billion; $400 million raised in January 2022
sources.source: FTX press release, Series C funding, 31 Jan 2022

sources.claim: FTX filed for Chapter 11 in Delaware on November 11, 2022, with Alameda and about 130 affiliated companies
sources.source: FTX public statement and voluntary petitions, US Bankruptcy Court, District of Delaware, 11 Nov 2022

sources.claim: FTX might owe more than a million customers
sources.source: FTX debtors' court filing, 15 Nov 2022 (reported by Reuters, 15 Nov 2022)

sources.claim: Alameda's chief drafted seven versions of its balance sheet for lender Genesis; the one sent hid borrowing from FTX
sources.source: Caroline Ellison trial testimony, US v. Bankman-Fried, SDNY, 10-11 Oct 2023

sources.claim: FTX launched in May 2019 and moved its headquarters from Hong Kong to the Bahamas in 2021
sources.source: FTX announcements; John J. Ray III First Day Declaration, 17 Nov 2022

sources.claim: Miami-Dade approved a 19-year, $135 million naming deal for the arena
sources.source: Miami-Dade County Commission approval, March 2021

sources.claim: FTX's Super Bowl advert ended on the line 'Don't be like Larry'
sources.source: FTX Super Bowl LVI advert, 13 Feb 2022

sources.claim: Forbes estimated the 30-year-old founder's fortune at about $24 billion
sources.source: Forbes World's Billionaires List, April 2022

sources.claim: The founder owned about 90% of Alameda Research, founded 2017
sources.source: John J. Ray III First Day Declaration, 17 Nov 2022

sources.claim: Binance exited its FTX stake in 2021 for about $2.1 billion in BUSD and FTT
sources.source: Binance CEO post on Twitter, 6 Nov 2022

sources.claim: Alameda's account could go below zero, was exempt from auto-liquidation, and had a $65 billion line of credit
sources.source: Gary Wang trial testimony, US v. Bankman-Fried, SDNY, 5-6 Oct 2023

sources.claim: FTX terms: 'Title to your Digital Assets shall at all times remain with you and shall not transfer to FTX Trading.'
sources.source: FTX Terms of Service, as quoted in SEC v. Bankman-Fried complaint, 13 Dec 2022

sources.claim: Customers wired dollar deposits to Alameda bank accounts, tracked as 'fiat@', about $8 billion by mid-2022
sources.source: Trial testimony (Ellison, Singh), US v. Bankman-Fried, Oct 2023

sources.claim: TerraUSD and Luna collapsed in May 2022, wiping out around $40 billion
sources.source: Reuters, May 2022

sources.claim: Celsius froze withdrawals in June 2022; Three Arrows Capital defaulted on loans
sources.source: Celsius statement, 12 Jun 2022; Voyager Digital notice of default, 27 Jun 2022

sources.claim: Ellison testified the founder told her to repay lenders with FTX money: 'He directed me to commit these crimes'
sources.source: Caroline Ellison trial testimony, SDNY, 10 Oct 2023

sources.claim: The founder testified he did not realise how large Alameda's debt to FTX had grown until late 2022
sources.source: Sam Bankman-Fried trial testimony, SDNY, 27-31 Oct 2023

sources.claim: FTX US offered BlockFi a $400 million credit line with an option to acquire
sources.source: BlockFi announcement, 1 Jul 2022

sources.claim: Alameda offered Voyager a loan facility worth about $485 million
sources.source: Voyager Digital press release, 22 Jun 2022

sources.claim: The founder testified to US lawmakers on crypto regulation in May 2022
sources.source: US House Committee on Agriculture hearing, 12 May 2022

sources.claim: Alameda assets $14.6 billion; $3.66 billion unlocked FTT; $2.16 billion FTT collateral; $8 billion liabilities incl. $7.4 billion loans, as of 30 June 2022
sources.source: CoinDesk, 'Divisions in Sam Bankman-Fried's Crypto Empire Blur on His Trading Titan Alameda's Balance Sheet', 2 Nov 2022

sources.claim: Binance said it would liquidate any remaining FTT
sources.source: Binance CEO post on Twitter, 6 Nov 2022

sources.claim: Alameda's co-chief offered to buy Binance's FTT at $22
sources.source: Caroline Ellison post on Twitter, 6 Nov 2022

sources.claim: 'A competitor is trying to go after us with false rumors. FTX is fine. Assets are fine.'
sources.source: Sam Bankman-Fried post on Twitter, 7 Nov 2022 (later deleted)

sources.claim: About $6 billion withdrawn from FTX in 72 hours
sources.source: Reuters, 8 Nov 2022, citing the founder's message to staff

sources.claim: FTX stopped processing most withdrawals on November 8; Binance signed a non-binding letter of intent
sources.source: Reuters, 8 Nov 2022; Binance CEO and FTX founder posts, 8 Nov 2022

sources.claim: FTT fell from about $22 to around $5 on November 8, about $3 by November 11
sources.source: CoinMarketCap FTT daily closing prices, Nov 2022 (rounded)

sources.claim: Binance withdrew, citing due diligence and reports of mishandled customer funds
sources.source: Binance statement on Twitter, 9 Nov 2022

sources.claim: FTX sought about $9.4 billion from investors and rivals
sources.source: Reuters, 10 Nov 2022

sources.claim: Bahamas regulators froze the assets of FTX Digital Markets on November 10
sources.source: Securities Commission of The Bahamas statement, 10 Nov 2022

sources.claim: John J. Ray III, who oversaw the Enron wind-down, became CEO
sources.source: FTX statement, 11 Nov 2022

sources.claim: Hundreds of millions left FTX wallets in unauthorised transfers that night (estimated $477 million)
sources.source: FTX US general counsel post, 12 Nov 2022; Elliptic analysis, Nov 2022

sources.claim: Ray: 'Never in my career have I seen such a complete failure of corporate controls...'; no full list of bank accounts; payments approved by chat emoji
sources.source: John J. Ray III First Day Declaration, 17 Nov 2022

sources.claim: Arrested in Nassau on December 12, 2022; extradited December 21; Ellison and Wang pleaded guilty
sources.source: Royal Bahamas Police statement, 12 Dec 2022; US Attorney SDNY statement, 21 Dec 2022

sources.claim: Convicted on all seven counts on November 2, 2023
sources.source: US v. Bankman-Fried verdict, SDNY, 2 Nov 2023

sources.claim: Sentenced to 25 years and ordered to forfeit $11 billion; customers lost over $8 billion
sources.source: US Department of Justice press release, 28 Mar 2024

sources.claim: He has appealed
sources.source: Notice of appeal, US Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit, April 2024

sources.claim: Ellison sentenced to two years
sources.source: SDNY sentencing, 24 Sep 2024

sources.claim: Estate estimated $14.5-16.3 billion to distribute; 98% of creditors to receive at least 118%
sources.source: FTX debtors' disclosure statement and press release, 7 May 2024

sources.claim: Plan approved October 2024; first payments February 2025
sources.source: US Bankruptcy Court, District of Delaware, confirmation order, 7 Oct 2024; FTX Recovery Trust, 18 Feb 2025

sources.claim: One bitcoin counted as $16,871 in FTX claims
sources.source: FTX debtors' digital asset conversion table, filed 2024

sources.claim: Bitcoin passed $100,000 in December 2024
sources.source: Reuters, 5 Dec 2024

sources.claim: Some customers objected that petition-date pricing left them short
sources.source: Objections in FTX Chapter 11 case, reported by Reuters, 2024

sources.claim: Miami-Dade ended the arena deal; renamed Kaseya Center
sources.source: Miami-Dade County, Jan 2023; Miami Heat announcement, April 2023

sources.claim: Lehman Brothers, founded 1850, filed for bankruptcy in September 2008
sources.source: Lehman Brothers Chapter 11 petition, SDNY, 15 Sep 2008
